input.command:
source /etc/network_turbo; cat > /tmp/download_assets.sh << 'SCRIPT'
#!/bin/bash
cd /root/autodl-tmp/libero_plus_assets/
URL="https://huggingface.co/datasets/Sylvest/LIBERO-plus/resolve/main/assets.zip"
OUTPUT="assets.zip"
EXPECTED_SIZE=6395849578

while true; do
    if [ -f "$OUTPUT" ]; then
        CURRENT_SIZE=$(stat --format="%s" "$OUTPUT" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
        if [ "$CURRENT_SIZE" -ge "$EXPECTED_SIZE" ]; then
            echo "Download complete! Size: $CURRENT_SIZE"
            break
        fi
    fi
    echo "$(date): Starting/resuming download..."
    aria2c -x 16 -s 16 -k 1M --check-certificate=false --file-allocation=none --max-tries=5 --retry-wait=10 --timeout=300 --connect-timeout=60 -c "$URL" -d /root/autodl-tmp/libero_plus_assets/ -o "$OUTPUT" 2>&1
    RESULT=$?
    if [ $RESULT -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "$(date): Download completed successfully"
        break
    else
        echo "$(date): aria2c exited with code $RESULT, retrying in 10s..."
        sleep 10
    fi
done
echo "$(date): Final file size: $(ls -lh /root/autodl-tmp/libero_plus_assets/assets.zip)"
SCRIPT
chmod +x /tmp/download_assets.sh
nohup bash /tmp/download_assets.sh > /tmp/download_assets.log 2>&1 & echo "PID=$!"

#!/bin/bash
ZIPFILE="/root/autodl-tmp/libero_plus_assets/assets.zip"
TARGET="/root/LIBERO-plus/libero/libero/"
EXPECTED_SIZE=6395849578

echo "Waiting for download to complete..."
while true; do
    if [ ! -f "${ZIPFILE}.aria2" ] && [ -f "$ZIPFILE" ]; then
        CURRENT_SIZE=$(stat --format="%s" "$ZIPFILE" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
        if [ "$CURRENT_SIZE" -ge "$EXPECTED_SIZE" ]; then
            echo "$(date): Download complete! Size: $CURRENT_SIZE"
            break
        fi
    fi
    sleep 30
done

echo "$(date): Backing up existing assets..."
if [ -d "${TARGET}assets" ]; then
    mv "${TARGET}assets" "${TARGET}assets_backup_$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S)"
fi

echo "$(date): Unzipping assets.zip to $TARGET ..."
cd "$TARGET"
unzip -o "$ZIPFILE" -d "$TARGET"
UNZIP_RESULT=$?

if [ $UNZIP_RESULT -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "$(date): Unzip successful!"
    echo "Assets directory size:"
    du -sh "${TARGET}assets/"
    echo "Lights directory file count:"
    ls "${TARGET}assets/scenes/lights/" | wc -l
    echo "Checking tabletop_light_sync_modified_130.xml:"
    ls -la "${TARGET}assets/scenes/lights/tabletop_light_sync_modified_130.xml"
else
    echo "$(date): Unzip failed with code $UNZIP_RESULT"
fi
SCRIPT
chmod +x /tmp/post_download.sh
nohup bash /tmp/post_download.sh > /tmp/post_download.log 2>&1 & echo "POST_PID=$!"
